title: From useful demo to responsible commerce
disclaimer: Independent community contribution. Devnet software is available; merchant settlement, vault deposits, contributor rewards and treasury actions are proposals only. No funds requested, guaranteed returns, approvals or launch dates.

arena.title: Solana Token Storefront
arena.description: Continuing stewardship of the forkable devnet storefront and review of responsible community commerce proposals. Repository-defined Arena; not provisioned in a private Devgraph host.

stages.title: 01 / Prove the devnet experience
stages.summary: Keep the demo forkable and close the gap between automated wallet tests and real extension approvals.

stages.title: 02 / Connect a willing merchant
stages.summary: Real products, real obligations, explicit permission. Staging orders before any production fulfillment.

stages.title: 03 / Model settlement working capital
stages.summary: Compare reserve and conversion policies with mock assets before building a money-handling system.

stages.title: 04 / Define contributor protection
stages.summary: Earned fees, honest valuation, bounded losses, and fair exits. No deposits are accepted.

stages.title: 05 / Earn the right to run a pilot
stages.summary: Operator-funded rehearsal first. Public capital and community treasury actions require separate approval.

work.title: Community-funded settlement: proposal for review
work.description: Explore token-native merchandise, a USDC reserve, earned contributor incentives, and a creator-approved community profit budget. No fundraising or launch approval is implied.

acceptance: Creator, merchant, contributors and reviewers explicitly agree scope before any capital collection.

work.title: Forkable storefront and exact-token cart
work.description: Eight active reference products, local artwork, variants, persistent cart, exact amounts and devnet-only payment configuration.

acceptance: Cart and amount tests pass; mainnet reference mint remains blocked.

work.title: Phantom and MetaMask integration
work.description: Desktop wallet connection and devnet transaction construction are implemented. Automated mocks and a developer-signed chain test are not installed-extension acceptance.

acceptance: Validate network, mint, amount, simulation and signed transaction; show submission rather than a paid-order claim.

work.title: Local inventory and reconciliation
work.description: Optional localhost stock, reservations, order snapshots and manual devnet reconciliation. No public production service or real fulfillment.

acceptance: Exercise stock reservation, expiry and reconciliation with isolated local tests.

work.title: Rehearse both real wallet extensions
work.description: Test installed Phantom and MetaMask desktop extensions with disposable devnet accounts; record versions and sanitized receipts.

acceptance: Approve, reject, disconnect and retry safely in each extension; exercise wrong-network and insufficient-funds cases.
No private keys or customer data in public evidence.

work.title: Agree the merchant relationship
work.description: Confirm rights, merchant of record, store-operator API authority, settlement asset and refund/support responsibilities. No consent is inferred from a public catalog.

acceptance: Written rights and operating agreement; staging access authorized.
Confirm whether USDC is accepted or an approved fiat rail is required.

work.title: Map SKUs to merchant products
work.description: Create an authorized staging adapter with product/variation mappings and authoritative stock, shipping, tax and landed cost.

acceptance: All active variant mappings verified; missing or stale products fail closed.
No production orders or customer information in test fixtures.

work.title: Verify payment before merchant fulfillment
work.description: Correlate quote, hold, reference, payment and merchant order; verify finality, prevent replay and make payout/order retries idempotent.

acceptance: Test duplicate, partial, late and unknown payments without duplicate payouts or shipments.
Only verified agreed-rail payment can advance a staging merchant order; setting paid does not itself transfer money.

work.title: Secure refunds and customer data
work.description: Define refund currency and costs; protect shipping data and credentials in a private authenticated service.

acceptance: Test cancellations, expired holds, refund failures and merchant outages.
Document consent, access, retention and deletion; never put personal data on chain.

work.title: Simulate reserve and conversion policies
work.description: Compare per-order swaps, periodic batching and threshold replenishment with mock prices, liquidity and demand. No live fund collection.

acceptance: Stress price collapse, missing routes, USDC impairment, refund spikes and simultaneous withdrawals.
Report minimum liquidity, unmet obligations, swap costs, DRU sold and capital-time; do not optimize swap count alone.

work.title: Build a bounded devnet reserve controller
work.description: Protect committed payouts and buffers; cap DRU exposure and holding duration; use executable quotes, hysteresis and atomic admission checks.

acceptance: Concurrent quotes cannot double-commit USDC; unavailable liquidity pauses new obligations.
No DRU holdings or in-flight funds treated as spendable USDC; integer accounting throughout.

work.title: Reconcile reserve, chain and merchant ledgers
work.description: Separate settled assets, in-flight payouts, customer liabilities, capital, earnings and community budgets.

acceptance: Idempotent reconciliation survives restart, reorg/finality delays and provider timeouts.
Deposits are never revenue; losses are recorded before distributions.

work.title: Optional cross-chain settlement decision
work.description: Use same-chain USDC first. Evaluate CCTP only if an approved merchant rail needs another chain; it is not a fiat off-ramp.

acceptance: Document a real cross-chain requirement before implementation.
Test burn/attestation/mint recovery and no double counting; otherwise leave this branch deferred.

work.title: Define capital rights and earned incentives
work.description: Agree a fee or creator-margin source, eligibility, conservative valuation, loss waterfall, funded first-loss capacity, caps and fair withdrawal terms.

acceptance: Qualified review of custody, contributor rights, jurisdiction, disclosures and tax obligations.
No promised APY, guaranteed principal, new-deposit-funded rewards or implied token-holder redemption rights.

work.title: Prototype fee and capital-time accounting
work.description: Allocate only realized distributable net fees after losses, obligations and required reserves; keep community profit separate.

acceptance: Zero safely distributable fees means zero rewards; rounding and boundary deposits tested.
Settlement fees deducted once before the campaign community-profit calculation.

work.title: Test fair exits and impairment handling
work.description: Simulate queued exits, notice periods, liquidity constraints and net-asset write-downs without offloading losses to remaining contributors.

acceptance: Run a mass-exit scenario alongside merchant/refund obligations.
Define share pricing, queue order, emergency gates and buffer exhaustion behavior.

work.title: Review custody and production controls
work.description: Threat-model signer authority, quote manipulation, mint controls, upgrades and outages; remediate findings and obtain independent review.

acceptance: Document multisig/timelocks and funded loss-buffer ownership if chosen.
Authentication, rate limits, monitoring, backups, emergency pause and recovery tested; no claim that CI is an audit.

work.title: Run a capped operator-funded staging rehearsal
work.description: After prerequisite evidence, exercise merchant staging orders and mock devnet settlement with no community funds or real shipments.

acceptance: Predeclare caps, stop conditions, operators and escalation; reconcile all test obligations and exceptions.
Publish sanitized results and remaining limitations before proposing any live pilot.

work.title: Agree community profit governance
work.description: Ask the creator to approve a percentage of positive distributable profit; define eligibility, quorum, conflicts, signers and execution evidence.

acceptance: Never spend customer obligations or contributor principal on a vote or burn.
Distinguish direct burns from buybacks and publish actual receipts, not promised price effects.

work.title: Separate approval for real funds and orders
work.description: A mainnet implementation and capped real campaign require new authorization after legal, security, merchant and operational gates. Community deposits are a later, separate decision.

acceptance: Explicit launch decision names accountable people, limits, customer terms and evidence.
No deposit button, mainnet vault or public fundraising until all applicable gates are met.
